senses.zh_definition: 肯尼迪：源于爱尔兰及苏格兰姓名传统的姓氏，也可用作名字；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname of Irish and Scottish origin, also used as a given name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada tradisi penamaan Ireland dan Scotland, dan turut digunakan sebagai nama peribadi.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，正文写作Kennedy。不能仅凭该词形断定指美国总统约翰·肯尼迪，也不能把姓名的历史来源当作现代词义。此处马来语释义为编写说明，并非DBP原文；搭配为常见专名组合，未提供语料频率统计。

etymology.historical_story: Kennedy preserves Gaelic naming history in an English spelling. Irish forms include Ó Ceannéidigh, while Scottish traditions include Mac Cinnèidigh. Such ancestral names became hereditary surnames, later travelling with emigrant families. Their historical components explain the name's development; they do not describe the appearance or character of present-day bearers. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=kennedy)
